_provenance.deliberately_excluded: status messages, goal text, tool arguments, tool results (args+results are sensitive — OURS-4)
_provenance.fields_included: session id, traceId, span name, status.code, aws.local.service, durationNano — the harvester's own projection

queries.pairs: fields traceId as trace, attributes.session.id as sid | filter attributes.aws.local.service like /mediaworks_harness/ | filter ispresent(trace) and ispresent(sid) | stats count() as n by trace, sid | limit 20000
queries.rows: fields @timestamp, attributes.session.id as sid, attributes.aws.local.service as svc, name, status.code as status, durationNano, traceId as trace | filter <session-id filter> | sort @timestamp asc | limit 10000

_provenance.regenerate: cd agent && AWS_PROFILE=megs-staging uv run python scripts/refresh_trace_fixtures.py
_provenance.row_selection: every span of each sub-session; for the parent, the first span of each trace it appears in (the join reads only the session/trace association)
_provenance.sessions: the 2 requests with the most plan sub-sessions in the last 14 days, chosen by shape (not by id, which retention rots)
_provenance.source: CloudWatch Logs Insights over the `aws/spans` log group, staging (100000000002, us-west-2), read-only StartQuery/GetQueryResults
_provenance.why_committed: REQ-017 needs real fixtures, and no other committed fixture holds a sub-session with a sibling, a parent, or a traceId at all

fanout_1.why: one request that fanned out into 6 plan sub-session(s); the parent appears in 18 trace(s)

fanout_2.why: one request that fanned out into 5 plan sub-session(s); the parent appears in 27 trace(s)
